_meta.note: CCBG-30: OpenAI always returns a reset time, even for a window nothing has touched yet. used_percent == 0 AND reset_after_seconds >= limit_window_seconds - 1 on the session window means 'not started' — resetsAtMs must come back nil despite reset_at being present.
